newsitem.title: CHINA: China plans for $157 mln loan to buy aircraft.
newsitem.headline: China plans for $157 mln loan to buy aircraft.

text.p: China's aviation authorities plan to budget for a 1.3 billion yuan ($157 million) loan to buy aircraft in 1997, the China Daily on Wednesday quoted Civil Aviation Administration of China chief Chen Guangyi as saying.
Chen said China's airlines expected to handle 62 million passengers in 1997, up about 12 percent from last year.

Air transport volume was expected to reach nine billion tonne-km this year, also an increase of about 12 percent, and airlines would transport 1.3 million tonnes of mail and freight this year, he said.
Some 80 million passengers would ride China's airlines by the year 2000 while transport volume would reach 12 billion tonne-km, Chen said.
